commits.subject: inbox(ajc-p2): archive 6 consumed claim/release/thread items, record 3 warning verdicts
commits.summary:
**Archived as consumed.** I-1116 (my own CLAIM on AJC.pic0av.reldim, superseded by my RELEASE I-1192), plus I-1101, I-1121, I-1123, I-1139, I-1140 -- CLAIM notices whose rows are done, rejected, or re-released by their own lanes. Each carries a one-line reason comment.

**Conversation closed as initiator.** I-1160 (hint to ajc-p3 on the uneven descent split of leaf B) archived with a conclusion: the asymmetry did not bear on sepclosed-section, because that row lands a point rather than a morphism property, so surjective+flat+quasicompact descent never applied. The live residue it surfaced stays tracked as I-1182.

**Warning verdicts recorded, not acted on.** AJC.picrep.etale-rep self-resolved mid-pass when ajc-p1 broke out a second child (galois); the roadmap active-count and the inbox caps are structural under ten free-claiming lanes, measured onto I-0509 and I-0556 rather than answered by archiving. New: I-1203 (the line-327 warning belongs to a queued lane) and I-1207 (blame the line, not the commit that touched the file).
